title: Animal ResearchTechnician
description:
Job Title: Animal Research Technician (Job ID: 36533872 )
Location: Athens, GA
Duration: 12 Months (Contract—Potential for Full-Time Conversion)
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM | 40 hrs/week

Position Overview:

Sigma Inc. is seeking a detail-oriented Animal Research Technician for a 12-month contract position in Athens, GA. In this role, you’ll play a key part in ensuring high standards of animal care, regulatory compliance, and support for pre-clinical research studies. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a Biosafety Level 1 and 2 animal research lab, with the potential to convert to a permanent full-time role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform daily animal husbandry duties including feeding, watering, enrichment, and health monitoring.

  • Maintain regulatory compliance per the Animal Welfare Act, NIH Guide, AAALAC accreditation, and internal SOPs.

  • Conduct routine health checks, record abnormalities, and administer basic animal treatments under supervision.

  • Assist with scientific procedures, clinical observations, and experimental treatments according to protocol.

  • Document care activities, health data, protocol-driven requirements, and USDA-mandated reports.

  • Support equipment sanitation, facility maintenance, and biosecurity efforts including water/feed sanitation and sample collection.

  • Aid in sample collection (blood, swabs, tissues) for pre/post-mortem clinical R&D studies.

  • Restrain animals for procedures and assist in sedation or euthanasia under veterinary direction.

  • Mentor junior staff and serve on site-specific committees as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Experience in animal care, agriculture, veterinary tech, or lab animal research strongly preferred.

  • Ability to work in extreme environmental conditions (hot, cold, humid, loud).

  • Must be able to lift up to 70 lbs occasionally and 50 lbs frequently.

  • Comfortable working with livestock and in proximity to animal allergens or dust.

  • Ability to maintain composure, follow protocol precisely, and manage detailed documentation.

  • Must possess strong communication, observational, and team collaboration skills.

  • Willingness to work with animals during ante-mortem and post-mortem procedures.

title: Accountant
description:
778740 Accountant | East Boston, MA | 6-Month Contract

Sigma Inc. is seeking a skilled Accountant to join our client’s team on-site in East Boston, MA.
This position is with the Commonwealth of Massachusetts – Massachusetts Port Authority (Massport), located at 1 Harborside Drive.

📅 Schedule: Monday–Friday, normal business hours (7.5 hours per day)
💼 Contract Length: 6 months
🏢 On-site Position

Position Summary

The Staff Accountant I will perform a variety of financial accounting and analysis functions to support accurate reporting and compliance with organizational policies. This includes general ledger reconciliations, bank and cash clearing analyses, journal entries, and variance reviews to ensure data accuracy and financial integrity.

Key Responsibilities

Cash Clearing and Reconciliation

  • Perform regular reconciliations of cash clearing accounts.

  • Ensure reported revenue aligns with bank activity and resolve discrepancies.

  • Monitor merchant (credit card) accounts and coordinate corrections.

  • Record all cash and credit card transactions accurately in ledgers.

Bank Statement and Cash Control Analysis

  • Code monthly bank activity to appropriate accounts.

  • Review and reconcile daily bank activity with the general ledger.

  • Notify management of variances and follow up on corrections.

  • Prepare daily cash analyses and monthly reconciliations for operational accounts.

General Ledger Reconciliation and Analysis

  • Reconcile general ledger accounts to subsystems and documentation.

  • Prepare and post journal entries for timely and accurate reporting.

  • Analyze accounts for irregularities or variances and prepare summary reports.

  • Complete month-end reconciliations and financial analyses on schedule.

Parking Revenue Accounting

  • Record and reconcile parking revenue, cash, and credit card deposits.

  • Verify deposit reports and ensure accuracy between internal and external records.

  • Investigate discrepancies and prepare related journal entries.

Special Projects
